title: verify_schema_baseline reports drift: 2 tenant schemas missing Postgres schema objects (tenant_277f51cc..., tenant_a319e29d...)
scope: Local/shared db (bpm_dev) tenant schema state only. Discovered as a byproduct of re-running zig build test-env-verify (checks C3/C4) while validating the ISS-0138 python3->python fix; unrelated to that fix.
symptom: `python tools/verify_schema_baseline.py --check-tenants` reports: '[FAIL] check_tenant_schemas_consistent: missing Postgres schemas for 2 tenant(s): 277f51cc-6878-445c-b010-ec648fcf95fc -> tenant_277f51cc6878445cb010ec648fcf95fc, a319e29d-ca2a-4255-bc52-aa2d987f2649 -> tenant_a319e29dca2a4255bc52aa2d987f2649'. This keeps `zig build test-env-verify` checks C3 and C4 failing, so the gate cannot report HEALTHY until resolved.
root_cause_analysis: Two tenant rows exist in the tenant registry table without a corresponding Postgres schema having been provisioned (or the schema was later dropped without deregistering the tenant row). Likely related to the same class of tenant-provisioning/migration-tracking desync documented in ISS-0101 (tenant_default shadow table) and ISS-0090 (orphaned tenant schemas from long-lived shared bpm_test container) but affecting bpm_dev rather than bpm_test, and the opposite direction (missing schema rather than orphaned schema).
acceptance_criteria: Either the 2 tenant schemas are provisioned (tools/verify_schema_baseline.py --auto-fix or equivalent), or the orphaned tenant registry rows are removed if the tenants are stale
zig build test-env-verify C3/C4 pass (assuming other checks are independently healthy)
